name: dbguard
description: Warns inline when a database migration will lock production: sizes, estimated lock time and the safer alternative, for Flyway and Liquibase on PostgreSQL and MySQL.

commands.title: DB Guard: Acknowledge this risk (add dbguard:ignore comment)
DB Guard: Show schema changelog for a table

dbguard.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `dbguard` binary (version 0.3.0 or newer). Download it from the [releases page](https://github.com/OriginalDaniel02/dbguard/releases).

dbguard.engine.markdownDescription: Database engine. Empty: detected from the connection string in `#dbguard.dsnEnv#`, else PostgreSQL.

dbguard.dsnEnv.markdownDescription: Name of the environment variable holding a **read-only** connection string. With it, DB Guard uses real table sizes. VS Code must be started with that variable set.

dbguard.tableRows.markdownDescription: Table sizes to assume when there is no connection string, for example `{ "transactions": 14000000 }`. Without sizes or a connection, every table is assumed large.

dbguard.largeRows.description: Tables with fewer estimated rows are treated as low risk.

dbguard.failOn.markdownDescription: Lowest risk shown as an **error** (the level that would fail your CI check). Lower risks are warnings or information.

dbguard.mysqlVersion.description: MySQL version to assume when not connected, for example 8.0.28.

dbguard.checkOnOpen.description: Check a migration when it is opened.

dbguard.checkOnSave.description: Check a migration when it is saved.

dbguard.checkOnType.description: Check while typing (debounced), using the unsaved text.

dbguard.include.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of migration files to check automatically. Flyway-named files (`V1__name.sql`) are always included. Use the **Check this migration** command on any other file.

dbguard.snapshotsDir.markdownDescription: Directory of schema snapshots written by `dbguard drift --save-dir`, used by **Show schema changelog**. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/core.test.js out/test/cli.test.js
